title: What does the outline include?
hook: Compare two representations of the same tiny shape.

doesNotKnow: How many background cells does this enclosing box include?

misconception: The primary and materially changed case must have the same consequence.
objective: Compute the segmentation per pixel construction and explain its countercase and stated boundary.

claims.text: What does the outline include? Compare two representations of the same tiny shape. How many background cells does this enclosing box include? Options: 0; 2; 4; 9.
claims.source: Finite owner construction: company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30.md §17; model.ts and model-check.mjs. Mathematical derivation supports only these declared operands and boundaries; source acquisition and independent checks remain pending.

claims.text: The cross’s box enclosed nine cells, including four background cells; its exact mask enclosed five with none. The solid rectangle made both representations include zero background cells. These are constructed output geometries, not measurements of a trained segmentation model’s accuracy.
